resources.string: Devices must configure a proxy manually

Enable Allow LAN, set a mixed port (for example 7890), and use 0.0.0.0 as the bind address. On the connected device, configure an HTTP or SOCKS proxy using this phone’s hotspot or LAN IP address and that port. Start Clash and select Rule or Global mode. Only traffic sent to the proxy follows that mode. Changes apply after leaving this page. Authentication uses username:password entries.
